answer: One fake identity costs 500 POA locked in a vault for 150 days, and the vault pays out only after that span of verified work, so a farm cannot split one stake across a thousand keys or rush it. Each completed job adds one grain to a dune of public reputation that buyers read before they hire. Three auditors drawn by lot from a wide nebula of strangers replay one job a month, and a forged entry burns the whole 500 POA and bars the key for a year.
